benchmark_scope: Fixed regression benchmarks used for release acceptance. Reviewed data/image fits are training regressions, not independent generalization or physical camera accuracy.

jpeg_replay.scope: Deterministic sampled reviewed JPEG holds, 12 frames each; training regression, not independent live accuracy

host_invoke.scope: warm host CPU invoke only; not iPhone or camera latency
warm host CPU invoke only; not iPhone or camera latency

onnx_latency.scope: Same-host alternating one-thread warm ONNX CPU calls; camera and physical device latency excluded

tflite_latency.scope: Same-host one-thread warm native CPU invoke only; excludes camera, transport, detector, isolate, display and confirmation.
tflite_latency.methodology: 100 warmup invokes each; 40 alternating-order rounds of the same 100 feature rows; set_tensor excluded from invoke timer.

retained_runtime_policy.strong_confirmation: immediate at confidence >= 0.92 and margin >= 0.25 after mass/geometry qualification
retained_runtime_policy.ordinary_confirmation: two matching results among latest three

limitations: Reviewed landmarks and images are training regressions, not independent subjects or live-camera accuracy.
Fixed regression benchmarks were reused for release acceptance; no validation/test data supplied training gradients.
Larger fits were rejected. The accepted training-fit improvement is modest: 628 to 630 of 990.
Forty-two new JPEGs were deleted; their saved landmarks remain training inputs. The image replay is a deterministic sample of 48 available photos.
The six baseline fist-orientation/hand-ownership test failures remain. Physical phone/NCM latency, new-camera accuracy and iOS builds need acceptance.
